component.name: NBDisk
component.summary: Connect and manage remote NBD disks

description.p: NBDisk is a Qt/KDE client for the Network Block Device (NBD) protocol. It connects remote exports to local /dev/nbd devices, shows their state, and mounts or unmounts the resulting volumes through udisks.

Connections can be created with nbd-client or qemu-nbd, and privileged operations are requested through polkit. Each device can keep a saved profile, reconnect automatically at startup, and mount volumes at configured mount points. LUKS-encrypted volumes can be unlocked and locked with cryptsetup. NBDisk can also start at login.
